examined_formations.title: SAAS_AND_CLOUD_SLA_CREDIT_RECOVERY
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Complaya, Reclivio and AllCaps already monitor vendor SLAs, detect breaches, calculate contractual credits, prepare/file claims and track recovery. The exact contract-value loop is already a product category.

examined_formations.title: VENDOR_REBATE_AND_TIERED_DISCOUNT_RECOVERY
examined_formations.chinese_title: 供应商返利与阶梯折扣漏领追回
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Kingdee, Yonyou/Chanjet, DMS/PRM systems and industry-specific rebate products already configure tiered rebate rules, ingest transaction data, calculate accruals and settle/reconcile rebates.

examined_formations.title: CONTRACT_TO_INVOICE_PRICE_PROTECTION_AND_CREDIT_AUDIT
examined_formations.chinese_title: 合同到发票价格保护与Credit审计
examined_formations.evidence_summary: AllCaps and Sirion already connect contracts, invoices, performance/SLA data and billing to detect credits, pricing mismatches and value leakage.

examined_formations.title: SUPPLIER_CLAIM_AND_CONTRACTUAL_DEDUCTION_RECOVERY
examined_formations.chinese_title: 供应商索赔与合同扣款追回
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Supplier-claim/QMS tools and claims-resolution agents already validate deductions and claims against contract/SLA terms and route or post credits.
